title: Sustained CDIC-to-DVC MPEG delivery
symptom: Several historical VCD and DVC-heavy runs lost MPEG payloads, macroblocked periodically, or turned black. Addams Family Values USA's former dirty-disc symptom is closed and is retained only as historical evidence.
expected: The native CDIC to main-RAM/PCL to VMPEG path delivers every selected sector once and in order at hardware-correct timing.
revalidation_reason: Two deterministic 53165b3-plus-diagnostic runs prove the Addams 647-byte count is legal Layer-II synchronization, not a transport or decoder error. The dirty-disc symptom was already closed; the latest GUI run merely reconfirms that it remains absent. Other historical sustained-stream symptoms remain separately scoped.

input_events: script native menu navigation before sustained playback

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: Guest PCL buffers are reused before firmware submits their previous MPEG payload, or drive seek/response timing misses the CD-RTOS completion window.
supporting_evidence: The Accused trace observed one complete 2304-byte payload overwritten by the next sector.
Addams Family Values USA delivered only a fraction of its on-disc Philips Media MPEG before returning to the dirty-disc dialog.
Temporary nonstandard sector cadences materially changed delivered bytes and frames.
contradicting_evidence: Changing the nominal 75-sector rate is not a specification-backed correction and did not fully fix the affected titles.
The 7th Guest sustains working MPEG delivery on the same broad hardware path.
Current DMA-boundary tracing observes no full-PCL overwrite in either The 7th Guest or Addams Family Values USA.
Bounded guest-write provenance proves the lone Addams hash difference is an intentional two-byte SCR retime; the old 647-error count exactly equals the legal MP2 frame-sync prefix.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Trace CDFM PCB/CIL/PCL ownership and drive completion timing on ac20dcd, then compare the first missing payload against a working sustained-MPEG title.
citations: Green Book VII CDFM SS_Play PCB/CIL/PCL

context.scenario: Accused and Addams Family Values diagnostic runs

experiments.strategy: Compare on-disc elementary streams with native-path captures and vary only diagnostic sector cadence.
assumptions: Temporary cadence changes are diagnostic only.
experiments.expected: A transport loss appears before MPEG decode when the issue reproduces.
experiments.actual: One Accused payload was overwritten; affected Addams playback captured only part of the source clip; cadence changes altered but did not eliminate the failure.

invalidated_by: CDIC, scheduler, CDFM/PCL, or replacement power-state changes
repeat_when: Reproducing on ac20dcd or later with exact revision capture

dependencies.diagnostics: DMA-boundary PCB/CIL/PCL ownership and payload hashes

context.scenario: 150M-instruction Addams VCD feature-path sample versus 650M-instruction The 7th Guest sustained-play sample

experiments.strategy: Decode native one-sector PCL chains at DMA boundaries, record fill/release/reconfiguration/overwrite events, and correlate normalized CDIC and VMPEG DMA payload hashes.
assumptions: PCL_BufSz is a sector count as specified by Green Book.
The normalized video transport hash excludes the 12-byte pack prefix.
experiments.expected: If current failure is simple PCL reuse, a producer write occurs while the prior one-sector PCL remains full.
experiments.actual: No overwrite risk occurred. The 7th Guest completed 1296 packs with zero decoder errors. Addams matched 463 of 464 normalized payloads; the lone audio mismatch at $22CD88 coincided with the first jump to 647 audio and stream errors, and its PCL was discovered only later.
improvements: Falsifiable ownership events now exist without changing machine behavior.
The active search is narrowed from global sector cadence to one transient audio-buffer interval.

conditions: ac20dcd device behavior with the diagnostic-only dirty diff
The exact Addams and The 7th Guest disc fingerprints recorded above
invalidated_by: Guest-memory write ordering or CDFM ownership changes
repeat_when: Bounded guest-write provenance can cover $22CD88 from CDIC completion through VMPEG DMA
A current GUI run confirms or disproves the user-visible dirty-disc symptom

dependencies.diagnostics: bounded changed-byte hashes for Form-2 CDIC destinations
dependencies.mp2: frame-header acquisition and malformed-frame outcomes reported separately

context.scenario: Two 150M-instruction Addams VCD feature-path repeats with the scripted native-menu click
context.timing: nominal 75-sector transport; no decoded-output behavior change

experiments.strategy: Watch each real-time CDIC DMA destination until VMPEG consumes it, hash intervening changed bytes, then locate the first valid MP2 header in the exact on-disc audio pack.
assumptions: Form-2 video and audio CDIC transfers are at least 2304 bytes.
Hash-only write provenance is observational and does not retain commercial payload.
Layer-II decoding may legally begin in the middle of an existing frame.
experiments.expected: A transport fault would modify MPEG elementary payload bytes, reuse a full PCL, or produce a malformed frame after synchronization.
experiments.actual: Only MPEG pack-header SCR bytes 7 and 8 changed before DMA2. The elementary payload was unchanged. Its first valid MP2 header followed a 647-byte mid-frame prefix, exactly matching the former error count. Both repeats produced 464 packs, 215 decoded video frames, 45 decoded audio frames, zero PCL overwrite, zero demux/video/audio/stream errors, and 647 audio-resync bytes.
improvements: Guest-side pack retiming is now distinguishable from payload corruption.
Expected MP2 synchronization distance no longer inflates malformed-stream counters.
The diagnostic run shrank from 48290 events to 5214 by excluding ordinary filesystem traffic and unchanged writes.

conditions: The exact Addams sample and native path recorded above
Current CDIC, PCL, DMA2, demux, and MP2 boundaries
invalidated_by: DVC DMA aggregation or MP2 frame-header parsing changes
repeat_when: A current GUI run reproduces a visible or audible Addams failure at a different boundary
Another title reports malformed frames after synchronization rather than startup resync bytes

manual_verification.notes: Additional confirmation of the already-closed Addams result: the title plays correctly in the GUI and the dirty-disc dialog remains absent.
